boundary: Derived software protocol. References are Qur'anic; labels, categories, confidence rules and numeric weights are engineering abstractions, not revealed numeric values or divine verdicts.

principles.role: Keep the assessment balanced and directed toward qist; do not distort or short-change the measure.
Apply the same standard despite self-interest, kinship, wealth, poverty, love or hostility.
Treat reports as requiring verification before conclusions that could harm people.
Do not promote an inference into knowledge when the supporting evidence is absent.
Distinguish mistake/unintentional conduct from deliberate intention while acknowledging that software does not know hearts.
Account for ability/capacity rather than assuming equal capability in every case.
Coercion can materially alter responsibility; the cited verse has a specific faith context, so software generalization is cautious and analogical only.
Do not transfer one person's burden to another; ancestry, group, media or environment are context, not inherited guilt.
Preserve small as well as large beneficial/harmful signals, keep benefit and harm separately visible, and do not treat an engineering net score as a revealed cancellation rule.
Keep a traceable record of what the model used so the subject can inspect the basis of the assessment.
Actual final divine weighing, inner righteousness and final destination remain outside the software model.
